description: This Swift source file defines enums and static methods for managing onboarding state and configuration within an application. It includes mechanisms to determine whether onboarding should be presented at launch, track completion status, display first run introduction, and manage last connection mode using UserDefaults.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be shown when the app launches, based on onboarding completion, last gateway connection, and app model state.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and optionally saves the last connection mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction has been seen; returns true if not.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating that the first run introduction has been viewed.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode from UserDefaults, if available.
